### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d795719926a2dacf7a394e23b717f36961343a26` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk` · 2026-10-16T05:39Z

This is the seat review of record for #23180's five `packages/spec/src/` rows (claim `6208272774`, report `6208706637`), on head `2b6764e25db9604afe67af892702db922ff9c771`. The diff touches test files only, so per the claim this review is the PR's record.

1. **Form.**
   - Draft to `main`. The first line is `Part of #23180`, with no closing keyword; the second is `Clause-②: no`.
   - 3 files, +53/−36, all test files. `skip-changeset`, following PR #23752.
2. **What it changes, read on the diff.**
   - **`src/ui/view.test.ts`.** Four cases loaded the `./shared`, `./ui` and `./api` entries with `await import()` inside the case. They now import them once at module top.
     - Every `expect` line is unchanged, and so is each identity check (`toBe` across entries).
     - This is the shape `AGENTS.md` prescribes: "Clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading — a test that boots a real plugin chain pays its first load at module top".
     - The PR body says the load moves rather than disappears.
   - **`src/ui/app.test.ts`.** The compiler-API case loaded `typescript`, `node:path` and `node:url` inside the case. It now imports them at module top. The case body is otherwise unchanged.
   - **`src/kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence.test.ts`.** Each file in the radius is now parsed once for both names, where the old walk parsed files holding both names twice.
     - The new-name scan is asked only of the three listed readers. `newReaders` has exactly one reader, `expect([...newReaders]).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(NEW_READERS))`, so only those three files can decide that assertion. The verdict is unchanged.
     - The old-name scan keeps the same radius and the same offender and positive-control assertions.
     - Both ablations went red as expected, and each restore was byte-equal: A1 dropped the old name from a reader, A2 dropped a new-name reader.
3. **Surface held.** Only three of the five claimed files changed. No helper, no non-test source, no retirement row, and nothing from `@objectstack/lint`.
4. **Gates.**
   - **CI on this head at this act:** 44 check-runs, 28 `success`, 10 `skipped`. `Test Core` 1–6 are still running, and auto-merge waits on them.
   - **Dev local:** 76 derived families.
     - 74 were run, all exiting 0. Two of them first exited 3, for a shallow clone and an unbuilt `@objectstack/formula`, and were re-run after the fix.
     - 2 are NOT-MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`). They need every package's dist, read no test file, and CI runs both.
     - Five-file run: 586 passed, 0 failed. Spec typecheck exited 0.
5. **Readings.**
   - **Recent CI** (three hourly runs that executed spec, Test Core (1/6) module line):
     - allow-org: 8.8 / 11.1 / 10.3 s
     - view: 9.1 / 10.7 s
     - app: 10.2 / 10.8 s
   - **Local before → after:**
     - view: 3.2–3.6 s → 0.19–0.22 s
     - app: 1.72–1.77 s → 1.17–1.26 s
     - allow-org (run alone): 1.24–1.31 s → 0.81 s
   - This PR's own `Test Core (1/6)` gives the first post-trim CI reading. No row is counted off here; the next refresh list decides each one, per the card's pin.
6. **Open question → #23821.** `scoped-context` and `connector-author-shape` read 14.0–18.1 s on CI.
   - Each is already one `ts.createProgram` (PR #23547), and the first probe pays the type-graph resolution.
   - That floor is neither of ruling `6181973363`'s two classes. The dev declared nothing, which is correct.
   - The seat filed decision card #23821 in this act (A: a third class; B: stretch "whole-package import"; C: stay listed). Both rows wait on it.
7. **Accepted deviations.**
   - The view and app trims move module load out of the clocked window. That is the `AGENTS.md` shape, and it is stated in the PR body.
   - Post-trim CI readings were not measured, because only the last 5000 log lines are readable from the container.
   - Local test scope was narrowed to the five files. CI runs both spec projects.
   - An unpublished commit's trailer was amended before the first push succeeded. Nothing published was rewritten.
   - `git fetch --unshallow` only added objects.
8. **Out of scope:** none reported, none found.
9. **Landing terms.** Ready, then auto-merge. `Part of #23180` leaves the card open. After the merge, the card returns to `pm:queue` with a `Release:` naming what remains.
